name: RADIUM
recent: Radium Development 在2026年9月软推出发展总值 RM435 million 的 Radium Evara 项目，位于 Kepong，截至10月已录得40%认购率。公司2026年6月季度营收同比增长75.2%，净利同比大增792.4%。
notable: 推出发展总值 RM435 million 的 Radium Evara 项目，位于 Kepong，截至10月录得40%认购率。
2026年6月季度净利同比增长792.4%至 RM7.005 million。
earnings: 2026年6月季度营收 RM74.616 million，同比增长75.2%，环比增长5.4%；净利 RM7.005 million，同比增长792.4%，环比增长51.5%；净利率9.4%，高于上一季度的6.5%。

recent_en: Radium Development soft-launched its RM435 million GDV Radium Evara project in Kepong in September 2026, recording 40% take-up as of October. For the quarter ended June 2026, revenue rose 75.2% year-on-year and net profit surged 792.4% year-on-year.
notable_en: Launched Radium Evara in Kepong with RM435 million GDV, recording 40% take-up as of October.
Net profit for the June 2026 quarter rose 792.4% year-on-year to RM7.005 million.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended June 2026, revenue was RM74.616 million, up 75.2% year-on-year and 5.4% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM7.005 million, up 792.4% year-on-year and 51.5% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 9.4%, up from 6.5% in the previous quarter.
